description: Election Commission - Declare that a member N. R. C. R. Pintu of the Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha, has Vacated his office of member of the United National Party Declare that a member L. C. Wickrama Arachchi of the Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member of the United National Party
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that two members of the Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is specifically done under Section 10 A(1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it a matter directly related to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, which falls under the Elections category.
